name: organic-growth
description: AI-powered organic growth engine for modern websites

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @organic-growth/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @organic-growth/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build:packages && npm run deploy -w @organic-growth/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @organic-growth/core && npm run build -w @organic-growth/ai && npm run build -w @organic-growth/db && npm run build -w @organic-growth/repo-analyzer && npm run build -w @organic-growth/crawler && npm run build -w @organic-growth/scraper && npm run build -w @organic-growth/pages && npm run build -w @organic-growth/agents && npm run build -w @organic-growth/sdk
